claims: Mr. Charles is introduced in season 2 of Daredevil: Born Again (2026).
Mr. Charles is played by Matthew Lillard.
Mr. Charles is not a prominent comic character.
Mr. Charles is described as a mysterious, high-level, "Cheshire Cat" style operator who deals with, rather than directly fights, characters like Kingpin.
Mr. Charles is heavily involved in illegal logistics, specifically moving military hardware into New York, according to mykxlg.com.
Mr. Charles works with Mayor Wilson Fisk to manage the fallout of a shipwreck cleanup at Red Hook.
Mr. Charles is created for the show by showrunner Dario Scardapane with Matthew Lillard in mind, according to GamesRadar+.
Mr. Charles is distinct from Charles Xavier (Professor X).
Mr. Charles is distinct from other established comic characters.
